_: THE PINE DATA FAMILIES (data unit S4-0, 2026-11-19): every non-price series a member's Pine script may read, the licensing-table pair it rests on, and the sentence the door shows. Read by app/src/components/chart/engine/pineDataCatalog.js (the chart's half) and api/services/pine_data_catalog.py (the server's half). A family is SERVED only when its pair's class is A or LA and it carries no hold; anything else is refused BY NAME. The `licence` block of each family is GENERATED from api/services/provider_licensing_class.py (`python -m api.services.pine_data_catalog --write`), never typed: tests/test_pine_data_catalog.py fails when it disagrees with the table. Nothing here serves a value yet: the supply that will read it is S4-3 onward.

rules.valuesLeaveProductWhy: Owner item O2, conservative default (coordinator 2026-11-19): a data family's value is never interpolated into an alert message, an export, a share or a model prompt. A condition may fire; the number stays in the member's chart.

sentences.licence: Not served: `{names}`. The {label} data rests on licensing class {class} ({rowText}), and a member's script reads only data classed A or LA.
sentences.unknown: Not served: `{family}` is not a data family this build knows.

earnings.label: earnings

refusedNames.earnings.standardized: No source we hold carries TradingView's standardized EPS.
refusedNames.earnings.future_eps: The next report's values are not served.
refusedNames.earnings.future_revenue: The next report's values are not served.
refusedNames.earnings.future_time: The next report's time of day is not held.
refusedNames.earnings.future_period_end_time: The next report's fiscal period end is not served.

earnings.disclosure: Earnings figures are UCT earnings data, not TradingView's.
earnings.definition: Reported and estimated EPS per report, placed on the bar TradingView places it (the placement is licensed only by the S4 probe captures).
earnings.history: the vendor's full history per symbol (about since listing)

dividends.label: dividend
dividends.disclosure: Dividends are UCT corporate-actions data, not TradingView's.
dividends.definition: Cash dividend per share on its ex-date, on the basis the S4 probe captures show.
dividends.history: the vendor's dividend history per symbol

splits.label: split
splits.disclosure: Splits are UCT corporate-actions data, not TradingView's.
splits.definition: Split ratio on its execution date, in the orientation the S4 probe captures show.

financial.label: financial
financial.disclosure: Financial figures are UCT data from company filings (10-Q and 10-K), each dated when its filing became public (which can be days after the earnings release), not TradingView's.
financial.definition: A mapped financial id and period (`fields`) read from UCT's point-in-time fundamentals store: each value is known from the first session whose close is at or after the instant its filing became public (never its fiscal period end) and is never graded as TradingView's figure (TradingView may date a value at the earnings release). Any other id or period is refused by name.
financial.history: 2009 (XBRL), per company from its first XBRL filing

fields._: THE MAP (track 4 F1, 2026-11-22): a `request.financial` id and period UCT serves, and the stored series of api/services/fundamentals_pit (catalog.py) it reads, each the same definition. Read by api/services/pine_financial.py (GET /api/pine/financial/{ticker}) and the chart's request.financial supply. `code` is the engine's two-letter name for the id (never renamed once served).

fieldsRefused._: Ids refused by their own name and reason (each a `code` the engine names it by). An id in neither list is refused as one UCT does not serve.

EARNINGS_PER_SHARE.why: UCT serves earnings per share as diluted GAAP EPS only (`EARNINGS_PER_SHARE_DILUTED`)

EARNINGS_PER_SHARE_BASIC.why: UCT serves earnings per share as diluted GAAP EPS only (`EARNINGS_PER_SHARE_DILUTED`)

GROSS_MARGIN.why: UCT holds gross margin over trailing twelve months only, which is not TradingView's per-period figure

TOTAL_DEBT.why: UCT does not hold total debt: filers tag debt too inconsistently for one definition

BOOK_VALUE_PER_SHARE.why: UCT does not hold book value per share

FLOAT_SHARES_OUTSTANDING.why: UCT does not hold float shares (it holds shares outstanding, `TOTAL_SHARES_OUTSTANDING`)

NET_INCOME.why: UCT holds net income from company filings, but its definition has not been matched to this id yet

TOTAL_ASSETS.why: UCT holds total assets from company filings, but its definition has not been matched to this id yet

TOTAL_LIABILITIES.why: UCT holds total liabilities from company filings, but its definition has not been matched to this id yet

ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE.why: UCT does not hold accounts payable

DPS_COMMON_STOCK_PRIM_ISSUE.why: UCT does not hold dividends per share from company filings (declared and paid figures are filed at different times)

EARNINGS_ESTIMATE.why: it is an analyst estimate, and company filings hold none

SALES_ESTIMATES.why: it is an analyst estimate, and company filings hold none

EARNINGS_DATE.why: UCT does not serve report dates through `request.financial`

FUND_FLOWS.why: it is a fund statistic, and company filings hold none

AUM.why: it is a fund statistic, and company filings hold none

periods._: The `period` argument: a letter the engine names it by, and why a period UCT does not serve is refused.

FY.why: UCT's filings store holds no fiscal-year series yet

FH.why: UCT's filings store holds no fiscal half-year series

D.why: UCT's filings store holds no daily financial series

uct_rs_rating.label: UCT RS Rating
uct_rs_rating.disclosure: UCT RS Rating is UCT's own calculation.
uct_rs_rating.definition: The IBD-style RS Rating (1 to 99) of the session, equal to UCT's stored rating history; daily only.
uct_rs_rating.history: the stored rating history (a one-year backfill, then nightly)

uct_rs_line.label: UCT RS line
uct_rs_line.disclosure: The UCT RS line is UCT's own calculation.
uct_rs_line.definition: Close divided by the benchmark's close, equal to UCT's RS line reader.

uct_breadth.label: UCT breadth
uct_breadth.disclosure: UCT breadth series are UCT's own calculations.
uct_breadth.definition: A UCT breadth symbol read with request.security("UCT:<symbol>", ...), membership decided by the registry; daily values, the previous completed session on an intraday chart.

uct_cot.label: Commitments of Traders
uct_cot.disclosure: Commitments of Traders series are UCT market data.
uct_cot.definition: A Commitments of Traders series read as a UCT symbol.
